title: You Slept Through It
logline: You wake from a coma in an empty hospital, 23 days into the end of the world. The doors are chained, something is pushing back, and the only one who came for you is a stray dog.

beats.scene: FRAME 0 IS ACTION. A dim hospital room, the light flickering. The door's frosted glass: a dark shape behind it, the handle rattling. You jolt upright in the bed (hospital gown, bandage).

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: You wake up. Something is at the door.
lines.captions: You wake up.|!Something!|is at the door.

beats.scene: The wall calendar: the days crossed out, 23 circled hard. Wilted flowers by the bed; dust on everything.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Twenty-three days. That's how long you slept.

beats.scene: You open the door: the hallway is empty. A tipped-over wheelchair, papers on the floor, lights dying one by one.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And nobody came to wake you.

beats.scene: Down the long hallway: double doors at the end, chained and padlocked. Grey fingers curl through the gap. The chain jumps.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: At the end of the hall, the doors are chained.
lines.captions: At the end of the hall,|the doors are *chained*.

beats.scene: A bark. In a side doorway: a scruffy shepherd dog with a red bandana. It barks again, then bolts for the stairs.
Outside, morning: you and the dog on Main Street. Abandoned cars, a police car, a school bus, shop signs. Nobody. Then, far down the street, one figure.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Outside, the whole town is empty.

beats.scene: The figure in the street turns its head: grey skin, white eyes. Then, all along Main Street, more heads turn toward you.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: One turns. Then all of them.

beats.scene: THE VOTE: you and the dog in the street, the walkers coming slowly from far behind; the police car to one side, the bus to the other, the hospital doors behind you.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Run for the police car. Hide in the bus. Or go back inside.

options.label: THE POLICE CAR
options.tag: MAYBE THE KEYS ARE IN IT
